vulnerability.explanation: Checks for prefixes with startswith(s, "-attr") while only ensuring s < e. Typical startswith implementations compare a fixed number of bytes (e.g., strncmp), which will read past the end of the [copy, e) buffer if s is within the last few bytes of the section and not NUL-terminated. Similar issues occur at the other startswith calls in this function.
